name: On Thin Ice
source:
A romantic sports visual novel where Delilah made for the winter game jam where Delilah attempts to legalize same-sex couples in figure skating.

After breaking up with her girlfriend due to rules against same-sex couples, Delilah decides to give up on her skating career and go to college to become a coach instead.

She meets someone who gives her the strength she needs to re-enter the world of figure skating, but in doing so runs into her ex at an event.

[From [url=https://ingred46sisu.itch.io/on-thin-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部为冬季游戏创作活动制作的浪漫体育题材视觉小说，讲述Delilah努力争取让同性组合获准参加花样滑冰比赛的故事。

由于禁止同性搭档参赛的规则，Delilah与女友分手，并决定放弃滑冰生涯，转而上大学，学习成为一名教练。

后来，她遇见了一个给予自己力量的人，让她重新踏入花样滑冰的世界，却也因此在一场活动中与前女友重逢。

[摘自[url=https://ingred46sisu.itch.io/on-thin-ice]Itch.io[/url]]
